messages:
Alex (AE): Hey team — Nimble Health procurement just sent back the MSA with three asks: add a 99.9% SLA, increase the liability cap to 6 months' fees, and require a PO before countersignature. Attached: Nimble_MSA_redline_v2.docx. Can legal + finance weigh in?

Sara (Legal): Saw it. The 6-month liability cap is a hard no from our side; we usually cap at 3 months or insurance carveouts.

Jen (Finance): PO-before-sign is fine for enterprise, but they want PO to be issued as net30 and reference a specific billing code. Need exact PO format and billing contact.

Olivia (PSM): Nimble is mid-POC — they want production cutover after POC ends. If we delay signature until PO arrives, they might push prod date. Can we offer conditional activation tied to PO submission?

Tim (Eng): Also a heads up — they added an EU data residency clause that would push this to Private deployment unless we accept contractual residency guarantees. That has infra cost implications.

Sara (Legal): Proposal: we can accept 99.9% SLA but with standard SLA credit language and a 10% monthly credit cap. We will decline 6 months' liability cap; counter to 3 months. For PO-before-sign, propose 'execution may occur electronically; customer may provide PO to trigger billing within 10 business days of execution' — keeps signature flexibility.

Alex (AE): That sounds reasonable. Can you draft redline text? I can loop customer in.

Sara (Legal): Drafted a few lines — dropping here for review:
```
SLA: Provider commits to 99.9% monthly uptime. If uptime < 99.9%, customer may receive service credits up to 10% of monthly fees for the impacted month. Credits are the sole and exclusive remedy for SLA failures.
Liability: Provider's aggregate liability for claims arising out of this Agreement will not exceed the greater of (i) three (3) months' fees paid in the prior 12 months or (ii) amounts required by applicable law.
PO / Billing: Customer may provide a purchase order for billing. Failure to provide a PO prior to countersignature shall not delay the Effective Date, but Provider will not be required to provision Dedicated resources until PO is received and validated.
```

Jen (Finance): The PO language is good. For billing contact: put invoicing@nimblehealth.com and require PO number format: NH-YYYY-######. Also confirm whether they need invoice-based tax docs.

Olivia (PSM): I'll offer a short-term workaround: we can provision onboarding with sandbox access immediately and provision limited capacity for production only after PO arrives. That keeps momentum.

Alex (AE): I'll send the counter-redline + ask for their PO template. Also they asked about pricing: they expect 15% discount for the annual commit; our sheet shows 12% band at that commit level. Can we make an exception?

Jen (Finance): We can do 13% if they sign a 12-month committed plan and a simple auto-renew. Need revenue manager approval for 15%.

Sara (Legal): Once I post the redline I'll attach to the thread. Can we get a sign-off from Revenue before I send? Reaction 

Alex (AE): Tagging revenue manager — @Jen (Finance) will follow up.

Tim (Eng): One more note: if we accept EU residency guarantee we should scope expected timeline (4–6 weeks) and costs. I'll prep a short implementation note to attach.

Olivia (PSM): I'll prepare a customer-facing execution plan: sandbox today, POC completion schedule, PO receipt milestone, production handoff. That can be attached to the counter.

Sara (Legal): Uploaded redline: https://redwood-workspace/attachments/Nimble_MSA_SaraRedline_v1.docx and created a DocuSign envelope draft for countersign: https://e.sign/abc123

Alex (AE): Thanks. I'll ping procurement and ask for PO template + confirm discount appetite.

eSign-Bot: DocuSign envelope "Nimble MSA (Redwood)" created by Sara (Legal) — envelope id 0A1B2C. Status: draft.

Alex (AE): Next steps: (1) revenue approval on 15% or settle at 13%, (2) Jen to confirm PO format + invoicing contact, (3) Tim to attach infra ETA/costs for EU residency, (4) Sara to send DocuSign once revenue OK. I'll update customer thread after we gather these. :thumbsup:
